tools.name: geocode_place
tools.description: Resolve a place name to latitude, longitude, timezone, and country with the Open-Meteo geocoding API. Use this when you have a city or landmark and still need coordinates. Do not use it for weather. Returns up to 10 matches. Read-only, no API key.

tools.name: current_weather
tools.description: Read the current temperature, wind, precipitation, cloud cover, and conditions at a latitude and longitude from Open-Meteo. Use this for the weather right now. Call geocode_place first when you only have a place name. Read-only, no API key.

tools.name: daily_forecast
tools.description: Read the daily high, low, precipitation, wind, sunrise, and sunset for a latitude and longitude from Open-Meteo. Use this for a multi-day outlook, up to 16 days. Call geocode_place first when you only have a place name. Read-only, no API key.

tools.name: hourly_forecast
tools.description: Read hour-by-hour temperature, precipitation probability, wind, and cloud cover for a latitude and longitude from Open-Meteo. Use this when the hour matters. Call geocode_place first when you only have a place name. Read-only, no API key.

tools.name: air_quality
tools.description: Read the current European AQI, US AQI, and pollutant concentrations at a latitude and longitude from the Open-Meteo air-quality API. Use this for air quality, smoke, or pollution. Call geocode_place first when you only have a place name. Read-only, no API key.
